title: India Summons Pakistan Diplomat Over Cross-Border Infiltration and Drug Smuggling
detail: India's Ministry of External Affairs summoned Pakistan's Chargé d'Affaires to lodge a formal protest over cross-border infiltration attempts and a drug-smuggling network linked to Pakistani territory. The summons is a separate incident from Pakistan's earlier summoning of India's envoy over civilian casualties, reflecting reciprocal diplomatic signalling amid the ongoing bilateral freeze.
